The two quotes cover the claim: a detached instance continues running and incurring charges, and it can be managed on its own or attached to a different group.
The dynamic scaling page says that when the capacity calculation falls outside the min-max range, the new capacity never goes outside those limits.
Under Multiple dynamic scaling policies, the page says that when policies trigger at the same time, the policy with the largest capacity is chosen for both scale out and scale in.
